verses.en: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
verses.pt: Cantarei das bondades do SENHOR para sempre; de geração em geração com minha boca anunciarei tua fidelidade.
verses.en_web: I will sing of the loving kindness of Yahweh forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.
verses.en_bbe: <Maschil. Of Ethan the Ezrahite.> My song will be of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make his faith clear to all generations.

verses.en: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
verses.pt: Porque eu disse: Tua bondade durará para sempre; confirmaste tua fidelidade até nos céus.
verses.en_web: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”
verses.en_bbe: For you have said, Mercy will be made strong for ever; my faith will be unchanging in the heavens.

verses.en: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
verses.pt: Tu disseste: Eu fiz um pacto com o meu escolhido, jurei a meu servo Davi. Eu lhe disse:
verses.en_web: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,
verses.en_bbe: I have made an agreement with the man of my selection, I have made an oath to David my servant;

verses.en: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
verses.pt: Confirmarei tua semente para sempre, e farei teu trono continuar de geração em geração. (Selá)
verses.en_web: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: I will make your seed go on for ever, your kingdom will be strong through all generations. (Selah.)

verses.en: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
verses.pt: Que os céus louvem as tuas maravilhas, SENHOR; pois tua fidelidade está na congregação dos santos.
verses.en_web: The heavens will praise your wonders, Yahweh; your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.
verses.en_bbe: In heaven let them give praise for your wonders, O Lord; and your unchanging faith among the saints.

verses.en: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
verses.pt: Porque quem no céu pode se comparar ao SENHOR? E quem é semelhante ao SENHOR entre os filhos dos poderosos?
verses.en_web: For who in the skies can be compared to Yahweh? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like Yahweh,
verses.en_bbe: For who is there in the heavens in comparison with the Lord? who is like the Lord among the sons of the gods?

verses.en: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.
verses.pt: Deus é terrível na assembleia dos santos, e mais temível do que todos os que estão ao seu redor.
verses.en_web: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?
verses.en_bbe: God is greatly to be feared among the saints, and to be honoured over all those who are about him.

verses.en: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
verses.pt: Ó SENHOR Deus dos exércitos, quem é poderoso como tu, SENHOR? E tua fidelidade está ao redor de ti.
verses.en_web: Yahweh, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? Yah, your faithfulness is around you.
verses.en_bbe: O Lord God of armies, who is strong like you, O Jah? and your unchanging faith is round about you.

verses.en: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
verses.pt: Tu dominas a arrogância do mar; quando suas ondas se levantam, tu as aquietas.
verses.en_web: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.
verses.en_bbe: You have rule over the sea in storm; when its waves are troubled, you make them calm.

verses.en: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
verses.pt: Quebraste a Raabe como que ferida de morte; com teu braço forte espalhaste os teus inimigos.
verses.en_web: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.
verses.en_bbe: Rahab was crushed by you like one wounded to death; with your strong arm you put to flight all your haters.

verses.en: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
verses.pt: Teus são os céus, também tua é a terra; o mundo e sua plenitude, tu os fundaste.
verses.en_web: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours; the world and its fullness. You have founded them.
verses.en_bbe: Yours are the heavens, and the earth is yours; you have made the world, and everything which is in it.

verses.en: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
verses.pt: O norte e o sul, tu os criaste; Tabor e Hermon têm muita alegria em teu nome.
verses.en_web: The north and the south, you have created them. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.
verses.en_bbe: You have made the north and the south; Tabor and Hermon are sounding with joy at your name.

verses.en: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.
verses.pt: Tu tens um braço poderoso; forte é tua mão, e alta está tua mão direita.
verses.en_web: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.
verses.en_bbe: Yours is an arm of power; strong is your hand and high your right hand.

verses.en: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
verses.pt: Justiça e juízo são a base de teu trono; bondade e verdade vão adiante de teu rosto.
verses.en_web: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.
verses.en_bbe: The seat of your kingdom is resting on righteousness and right judging: mercy and good faith come before your face.

verses.en: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
verses.pt: Bem-aventurado é o povo que entende o grito de alegria; ó SENHOR, eles andarão na luz de tua face.
verses.en_web: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: Happy are the people who have knowledge of the holy cry: the light of your face, O Lord, will be shining on their way.

verses.en: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
verses.pt: Em teu nome se alegrarão o dia todo, e em tua justiça serão exaltados.
verses.en_web: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.
verses.en_bbe: In your name will they have joy all the day: in your righteousness will they be lifted up.

verses.en: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
verses.pt: Porque tu és a glória de sua força, e por tua boa vontade nosso poder é exaltado.
verses.en_web: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.
verses.en_bbe: For you are the glory of their strength; in your pleasure will our horn be lifted up.

verses.en: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.
verses.pt: Porque ao SENHOR pertence nosso escudo; e o Santo de Israel é nosso Rei.
verses.en_web: For our shield belongs to Yahweh; our king to the Holy One of Israel.
verses.en_bbe: For our breastplate is the Lord; and our king is the Holy One of Israel's.

verses.en: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.
verses.pt: Então em visão falaste ao teu santo, e disseste: Pus o socorro sobre um valente; exaltei a um escolhido dentre o povo.
verses.en_web: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.
verses.en_bbe: Then your voice came to your holy one in a vision, saying, I have put the crown on a strong one, lifting up one taken from among the people.

verses.en: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
verses.pt: Achei a Davi, meu servo; eu o ungi com meu óleo santo.
verses.en_web: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,
verses.en_bbe: I have made discovery of David my servant; I have put my holy oil on his head.

verses.en: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
verses.pt: Com ele minha mão será firme; e também meu braço o fortalecerá.
verses.en_web: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.
verses.en_bbe: My hand will be his support; my arm will give him strength.

verses.en: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
verses.pt: O inimigo não tomará suas riquezas, nem o filho da perversidade o afligirá.
verses.en_web: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.
verses.en_bbe: The deceit of those who are against him will not overcome him; he will not be troubled by the sons of evil.

verses.en: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
verses.pt: Porém eu espancarei seus adversários, e ferirei aos que o odeiam.
verses.en_web: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.
verses.en_bbe: I will have those who are against him broken before his face, and his haters will be crushed under my blows.

verses.en: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
verses.pt: E minha fidelidade e minha bondade serão com ele; e em meu nome seu poder será exaltado.
verses.en_web: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.
verses.en_bbe: But my faith and my mercy will be with him; and in my name will his horn be lifted up.

verses.en: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
verses.pt: Porei a mão dele no mar, e sua mão direita nos rios.
verses.en_web: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.
verses.en_bbe: I will put his hand in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

verses.en: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
verses.pt: Ele me chamará: Tu és meu Pai, meu Deus, e a rocha da minha salvação.
verses.en_web: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’
verses.en_bbe: He will say to me, You are my father, my God, and the Rock of my salvation.

verses.en: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
verses.pt: Eu também o porei como primogênito, mais alto que todos os reis da terra.
verses.en_web: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
verses.en_bbe: And I will make him the first of my sons, most high over the kings of the earth.

verses.en: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
verses.pt: Manterei minha bondade para com ele para sempre, e meu pacto com ele será firme.
verses.en_web: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.
verses.en_bbe: I will keep my mercy for him for ever; my agreement with him will not be changed.

verses.en: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.pt: Conservarei sua semente para sempre, e o trono dele como os dias dos céus.
verses.en_web: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
verses.en_bbe: His seed will keep their place for ever; his kingdom will be eternal, like the heavens.

verses.en: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
verses.pt: Se seus filhos deixarem minha Lei, e não andarem em meus juízos,
verses.en_web: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;
verses.en_bbe: If his children give up my law, and are not ruled by my decisions;

verses.en: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
verses.pt: Se profanarem os meus estatutos, e não guardarem os meus mandamentos,
verses.en_web: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;
verses.en_bbe: If my rules are broken, and my orders are not kept;

verses.en: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.pt: Então punirei a transgressão deles com vara, e a perversidade deles com açoite,
verses.en_web: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
verses.en_bbe: Then I will send punishment on them for their sin; my rod will be the reward of their evil-doing.

verses.en: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
verses.pt: Porém nunca tirarei minha bondade dele, nem falharei em minha fidelidade.
verses.en_web: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.
verses.en_bbe: But I will not take away my mercy from him, and will not be false to my faith.

verses.en: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
verses.pt: Não quebrarei o meu pacto, e o que saiu dos meus lábios não mudarei.
verses.en_web: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.
verses.en_bbe: I will be true to my agreement; the things which have gone out of my lips will not be changed.

verses.en: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
verses.pt: Uma vez jurei por minha Santidade, e nunca mentirei a Davi.
verses.en_web: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.
verses.en_bbe: I have made an oath once by my holy name, that I will not be false to David.

verses.en: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
verses.pt: A semente dele durará para sempre, e o trono dele será como o sol perante mim.
verses.en_web: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.
verses.en_bbe: His seed will not come to an end for ever; the seat of his kingdom will be like the sun before me.

verses.en: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
verses.pt: Assim como a lua, ele será confirmado para sempre; e a testemunha no céu é fiel. (Selá)
verses.en_web: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.
verses.en_bbe: It will be fixed for ever like the moon; and the witness in heaven is true. (Selah.)

verses.en: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
verses.pt: Porém tu te rebelaste, e o rejeitaste; ficaste irado contra o teu Ungido.
verses.en_web: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.
verses.en_bbe: But you have put him away in disgust; you have been angry with the king of your selection.

verses.en: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.
verses.pt: Anulaste o pacto do teu servo; desonraste a coroa dele lançando-a contra a terra.
verses.en_web: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.
verses.en_bbe: You have made your agreement with your servant of no effect: you have had no respect for his crown, it has come down even to the earth.

verses.en: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
verses.pt: Derrubaste todos os seus muros; quebraste suas fortificações.
verses.en_web: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.
verses.en_bbe: All his walls are broken down; you have given his strong towers to destruction.

verses.en: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
verses.pt: Todos os que passam pelo caminho o despojaram; ele foi humilhado por seus vizinhos.
verses.en_web: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.
verses.en_bbe: All those who come by take away his goods; he is laughed at by his neighbours.

verses.en: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
verses.pt: Levantaste a mão direita de seus adversários; alegraste a todos os inimigos dele.
verses.en_web: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.
verses.en_bbe: You have given power to the right hand of his haters; you have made glad all those who are against him.

verses.en: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
verses.pt: Também deixaste de afiar sua espada; e não o sustentaste na batalha.
verses.en_web: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.
verses.en_bbe: His sword is turned back; you have not been his support in the fight.

verses.en: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
verses.pt: Fizeste cessar sua formosura; e derrubaste seu trono à terra.
verses.en_web: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.
verses.en_bbe: You have put an end to his glory: the seat of his kingdom has been levelled to the earth.

verses.en: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.pt: Encurtaste os dias de sua cidade; cobriste-o de vergonha. (Selá)
verses.en_web: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.
verses.en_bbe: You have made him old before his time; he is covered with shame. (Selah.)

verses.en: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
verses.pt: Até quando, SENHOR? Tu te esconderás para sempre? Arderá teu furor como o fogo?
verses.en_web: How long, Yahweh? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?
verses.en_bbe: How long, O Lord, will you Keep yourself for ever from our eyes? how long will your wrath be burning like fire?

verses.en: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
verses.pt: Lembra-te de que curta é minha vida; por que criarias em vão todos os filhos dos homens?
verses.en_web: Remember how short my time is! For what vanity have you created all the children of men!
verses.en_bbe: See how short my time is; why have you made all men for no purpose?

verses.en: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
verses.pt: Que homem vive, que não experimente a morte? Livrará ele a sua alma do poder do Xeol? (Selá)
verses.en_web: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.
verses.en_bbe: What man now living will not see death? will he be able to keep back his soul from the underworld? (Selah.)

verses.en: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
verses.pt: Senhor, onde estão as tuas bondades do passado, que juraste a Davi por tua fidelidade?
verses.en_web: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?
verses.en_bbe: Lord, where are your earlier mercies? where is the oath which you made to David in unchanging faith?

verses.en: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;
verses.pt: Lembra-te, Senhor, da humilhação de teus servos, que eu trago em meu peito, causada por todos e grandes povos.
verses.en_web: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
verses.en_bbe: Keep in mind, O Lord, the shame of your servants, and how the bitter words of all the people have come into my heart;

verses.en: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
verses.pt: Com humilhação os teus inimigos insultam, SENHOR, com a qual insultam os passos do teu ungido.
verses.en_web: With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
verses.en_bbe: The bitter words of your haters, O Lord, shaming the footsteps of your king.

verses.en: Blessed be the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
verses.pt: Bendito seja o SENHOR para todo o sempre. Amém, e Amém. Oração de Moisés, homem de Deus:
verses.en_web: Blessed be Yahweh forever more. Amen, and Amen.
verses.en_bbe: Let the Lord be praised for ever. So be it, So be it.
